title: silene cinerea var. cirtensis
intro: Silene cinerea var. cirtensis, commonly known as White Campion, is a flowering plant species in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat a range of health issues, with its health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Silene cinerea var. cirtensis are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
